sentences.text: Phaethusavis is an extinct genus belonging to the family Phaethontidae within the order Phaethontiformes.
The type species of the genus Phaethusavis is Phaethusavis pelagicus, the species the genus is based on.
The genus Phaethusavis was described by Bourdon and colleagues in 2008.
Only one fossil occurrence of Phaethusavis has been recorded, found in the Ouled Abdoun Basin in Morocco.
This animal lived during the Eocene epoch, specifically between 56 and 48.07 million years ago.
Fossils of Phaethusavis date to the Ypresian stage.
